Doctor Registration & Licensing

Compliance Automation

Automated registration validation checking GMC licensing requirements, qualification recognition, and provisional/full registration pathways against the Medical Act 1983.

Risk Detection & Early Warning

Detection of registration fraud, qualification irregularities, and fitness-to-practise concerns during application via pattern analysis and verification checks.

NLP analysis of registration applications, sponsorship letters, and qualification documentation against GMC registration standards and guidance.

Registration risk scoring from application completeness, qualification pathway, prior regulatory history, and sponsor assessment quality.

Registration dashboards showing application volumes, processing times, overseas registration trends, and licensing pathway distributions.

Real-time Monitoring

Registration application processing, qualification verification tracking, and licensing status monitoring across all application streams.
